detailed_description: Doughnut Chart Generator renders an ECharts doughnut (pie with inner hole) chart from a small editable browser-side data table. Use Load Sample to fill example browser-share data or edit name/value rows yourself with add/remove buttons. Configure chart title, color theme (default, ocean, sunset, forest), rose type (none, radius, area), inner radius slider 0-60%, outer radius slider 40-90%, and toggles for legend and labels. The preview updates reactively and PNG or SVG can be downloaded at 2x pixel ratio via ECharts getDataURL. The tool does not import CSV/JSON files, fetch live data, run statistical analysis, embed dashboards, or output editable SVG metadata beyond the ECharts export.
usage_steps: Click Load Sample to fill the data table, or edit name and value cells directly
Use + Add Item or the row delete button to manage entries (at least one row is kept)
Set the chart title and pick a color theme: default, ocean, sunset, or forest
Pick a rose type (none, radius, area) and drag inner radius 0-60% and outer radius 40-90%
Toggle Show Legend and Show Label to control the legend and slice labels
Click Download PNG or Download SVG to export the current ECharts view
usage_examples: Show the browser share sample data and download a PNG for a slide deck
Edit name/value rows to chart a small budget breakdown and export an SVG
Switch on rose type radius for a Nightingale-style variant of the same data
Tighten the inner radius and toggle labels to fit the chart into a tight dashboard tile
